gameweeks.matchReport:
High energy, big smiles and positive attitudes. Started off well with good structure, solid effort winning tackles and speedy fast breaks. First half ended 2-1 up.  
Second half started similarly and went up 3-1 with some good ball winning tackles. 
Lost some structure and ran out of legs towards the end. 
Very entertaining first game. Looking to build on it.
gameweeks.success: Teamwork and encouragement. Good finishes, tackling and fast breaks.
gameweeks.improvements: Spacing and keeping to positions. Let the ball do the work.

gameweeks.matchReport:
Great all-round performance by the team. Big smiles as always. 
Up 2-0 at half time with strong running, tackles and communication. Kept it going in the 2nd half to come up with a deserved 5-1 win.  
A very proud team.
gameweeks.success: Passing improved and kept our shape. Stayed focused and disciplined with our positions.
gameweeks.improvements:
What to do in set pieces (goal kicks and corners) - how to defend them and what to do when we are taking them. 
Continue to work on passing and scanning/looking around.

gameweeks.matchReport:
A high energy performance by the entire team. With 2 subs, the players kept their foot on the gas. Up 3-0 at half time and never let up ending with a commanding 10-0 win. 
Each individual is growing in confidence with each game.
Fantastic to see the additional cheer squads from families and friends.
gameweeks.success:
The team's pace and pressure to win the ball and getting stuck into tackles, even at the cost of some bumps, bruises and tumbles. 
Discipline of team's structure, especially from our defence and keeper when there was little action.
gameweeks.improvements: Passing can still be improved, looking for our teammates and using

gameweeks.matchReport:
A highly contested game against good opponents challenged our girls to dig deep and stay focused. 
Up 3-0 at half time with great team play and amazing saves by our keeper. 
Second half was scoreless showing a battle of determination between both sides. 
In the end a rewarding 3-0 win continuing the team's positive momentum.
gameweeks.success:
Defense in both halves was disciplined.
Pressure on the ball and great tackling to win the ball. 
Improvement in using names when passing.
gameweeks.improvements:
Throw-in technique to avoid retakes.
Passing when we have an advantage in numbers on a fast break.

gameweeks.matchReport:
Up against our toughest opponent to date, the team showed grit and determination to give it all they've got up until the final whistle. 
Having gone down by a wonder goal our girls kept their heads up and scored 2 unanswered goals to go up 2-1 at half time. 
Second half was a tough battle without subs and even playing short 1 player for a few minutes. 
A further goal was scored by each side in the second half, with our superstars coming away with a hard fought 3-2 win.
gameweeks.success:
Defense solid as always. 
Midfielders and attackers pressure on the opponents.
Big improvement in speed and effectiveness of throw-ins (as practiced)
gameweeks.improvements:
Defending opponents quick goal kicks and throw-ins. 
Constantly scanning of teammates and opponents.

gameweeks.matchReport:
A frantic day with crazy socks and double the amount of Rangers. Highlight of the day was the mums sharing their special day with everyone.
Started off with an early goal. Both teams took a while to get into the rhythm of the game, but we battled well to stay 1-0 up at the half. 
Second half was more free flowing with some nice passes which led to the team scoring 3 further goals while keeping our wall of defense solid as always.
gameweeks.success:
Tackling and defense. 
Pressure on the opponents.
Corners
gameweeks.improvements:
Scanning & Spacing for teammates 
Positions 
Taking less touches (to pass or shoot)

gameweeks.matchReport:
Another strong and solid performance by the team despite the early start, cold weather and heavy fog.
Our structure remains solid anchored by our backline (Goalkeeper & defense) allowing our attackers freedom to pressure the opponents and win the ball high up the field to create opportunities to score.  
The girls showed great resolve with a few players not feeling 100% but pushing through showing it's all about the TEAM.
gameweeks.success:
Ball winning tackles
Defensive structure and discipline.
gameweeks.improvements:
Scanning (looking up) with and without the ball
Sticking to positions (central & side to side) to create space
Passing (spreading the field)
Talking to our teammates (avoid running into each other)

gameweeks.matchReport:
A dominating performance by the girls keeping the pressure on the entire game. Goods runs and finishes showed an improvement in striking the ball. 3-0 up half time and a further 7 to match the largest win of the season. 
The team is gelling very well with less in game 'instructions' required, allowing the girls to be independent and creative. 
This promotes player growth for all to see.
gameweeks.success:
Ball striking leading to good finishes.
Kept to positions.
Attacking pressure on the opposition goal kicks. 
Defensive discipline and consistency.
gameweeks.improvements:
Side to side passes 
Scanning to avoid running into teammates.
Getting teammates involved with passes close to goal.

gameweeks.matchReport:
First game in the Catley division after being regraded, we knew we were going to be up against much tougher opponents. 
We had our moments and battled hard with our physicality, however it was not enough to avoid the first loss of the season. 
Our opponents passed and pressured well, leaving us with very little time on the ball. 
At the final whistle, the girls were down on themselves however we should be encouraged that
- we stayed competitive
- it showed where we can improve individually and as team
- the goals we conceded can be avoided with basic drills. 
Keep your heads up Rangers!
gameweeks.success:
We stayed competitive despite a level up in competition.
Tackled and being physical without fouling.
gameweeks.improvements:
1. Jewellery - Parents please ensure jewellery (necklace, earrings, rings, etc) are not worn at games, otherwise players will not be allowed to play. Earrings which cannot be removed must be taped up with tan coloured tape.   
2. Our goal kicks - Know who to pass the ball to, and what positions we need to be in. 
3. Positions - Right, Left, Upfront, Back, Midfield, Everywhere. If we don't stick to our allocated positions, we will be exposed when being attacked and will lose opportunities when we are on the attack.
4. Time on the ball - quicker decisions and movements to avoid pressure. 
5. Passing to players space

gameweeks.matchReport:
Defense was solid and composed apart from being outnumbered in transition from opposition.
Midfield worked well as a unit. But had difficulty covering ground due to fatigue. No subs available. 
Right mid and LM worked hard moving forward and back sticking to position.
CF made clean breaks through the middle of the first half. 

Overall performance was great, with most of the girls following instructions and keeping formation.
gameweeks.improvements:
Keep working on position duties and formation. Communication within the team.
Fixed roles for key positions.

gameweeks.matchReport:
A tight and intense well fought out game which was decided with a very late goal for the Rams. Having no subs and against a skilled opponent, our girls played their hearts out until the very end. 
Passing and positions have been improving however we can still work on spreading out and making quick passes when attacking.
Overall, very proud of the team's performance and their progress.
gameweeks.success:
Defense was disciplined
Players kept to their positions
gameweeks.improvements:
Space / Spreading out
Passing 
- quick and strong passes
- side to side passing (spreading the field)
Clearances on goal kicks

gameweeks.matchReport:
An intense match which could have gone either way. Rangers pressured the opposition most of the first half, creating a number of chances and scoring a vital goal before half time. 
Second half, fatigue set in leaving holes when counter attacked. 
The opposition had the better chances in were awarded with a late goal to draw it level. A great effort by the team with visible improvements in team play.
gameweeks.success:
- Intensity and pressure to win the ball 
- Key passes to create goal scoring chances 
- Defensive support and recovery
gameweeks.improvements:
- Parents please try be on time (30 mins before kick off). We need to give the players enough time to warm up and get instructions as an individual and a team. 
- Follow up on shots in attack and defense
- Running into space to support runs and provide options when attacking.
- Focus until the very end

gameweeks.matchReport:
Another tightly contested game which required the team to dig deep having to play without subs against a talented opponent. The team-work was in full display where the girls did amazingly well to help each other on defense even when outsized. 
The team is passing much better, finding teammates to progress the ball forward. 
Another step in the right direction and a pleasure to watch  (as a parent, coach, manager or referee).
gameweeks.success:
- Passing to teammates 
- Multiple efforts in defense (not giving up)
- Supporting runs (not running into each other)
gameweeks.improvements: - Getting the ball out from the feet (first touch)

gameweeks.matchReport: A great display of team work ending with a well deserved first win in Catley. A result which mirrored the continuous improvement in passing and spacing while staying disciplined in our defense.
gameweeks.success:
- Passing 
- Defensive discipline
- Supporting runs and defensive cover
gameweeks.improvements:
- Sticking to positions (side of the field)
- Throw ins (technique)
- Square passes (for supporting runs)
- Follow up tackles

gameweeks.matchReport:
A rematch of a few weeks ago which once again was tightly contested and could have gone either way. 
We had many chances to score which resulted in some good saves by a determined keeper. 
Many lessons to learn in keeping composure under pressure.
gameweeks.improvements:
- Positions on goal kicks (both ours and the opponents)
- Final pass - too close to the keeper rather than to a supporting player.
- Finishing (shot direction)
- Handling pressure and physicality

gameweeks.matchReport:
A rematch from a few weeks ago which saw the same determination to win by the team. Constant pressure up high on the field while breaking down any chance of a counter attack. 
We passed well and got into great positions through support runs. 
A well deserved win for the team while showing sportsmanship throughout the game.
gameweeks.success:
- Pressure on the defense
- Passing
- Support runs
gameweeks.improvements:
- Spreading out
- High balls (how to control)

gameweeks.matchReport: A come from behind gutsy effort by the team. We had the majority of possession and chances however our opponents were a threat on the counter attack.
gameweeks.success:
- Pressure up high 
- Winning the ball in tackles and not giving up on the play
- Some good supporting runs
gameweeks.improvements:
- Playing for the team. Need to remind ourselves that everyone plays a role.
- Avoid crashing into teammates
- Arriving 30mins before kick off on game time. It creates confusion within the team if players arrive late. We need to give ourselves the best chance to perform well.
